review.candidate_state: Two untracked files bound by the per-candidate hashes below; this is not an exact-clean-head unit receipt.
reviewed: bounded search of existing local training patterns

language_boundary.allocation: Ordinary global new/delete; no replacement allocator is introduced. A throwing allocation creates no returned owned object. Receiver defect is on the successful-allocation path.
language_boundary.execution: Fragments are translation units for analysis, not standalone executables. The receiver's method remains declaration-only; no invented body was added.
language_boundary.removed_harness: Unrelated cases, test-driver directives and the simulator include were omitted. Retained statements match the indicated source ranges, but complete harness equivalence is not established.
language_boundary.native_profile: NOT_FROZEN; local syntax-only GCC checking is not native product qualification.

candidates.rationale: Deleting the successfully allocated object ends its lifetime before the subsequent non-static method invocation on the expired receiver. A missing method body does not validate that receiver. The null argument alone is not a null-dereference finding.

duplicate_evidence.reason: Existing allocate/delete/declaration-only member-call training pattern; names and the extra null argument do not establish independence.

candidates.future_boundary: May only be considered as training-linked supplemental evidence, never as new independent quota on this selection.

candidates.rationale: Visible allocate() creates exactly Derived. The Base-pointer return and downcast preserve that object's identity; matching delete releases it. Empty visible destructors introduce no owned resources. Ordinary allocation failure precedes a returned owned object.

duplicate_evidence.reason: Existing training already combines a visible allocation wrapper, caller-side pointer cast and matching release. The configured allocator and later use differ, so this is a memory-leak-family overlap, not an all-rule-safe comparison. The empty Base/Derived round-trip adds typed integration coverage but does not establish a separate ownership obligation or release path for independent quota.

source_adjudication.standalone_dependency_boundary: Select this header-free C++17 translation unit with ordinary global single-object new/delete, no replacement allocator or interposition, and the visible helper and empty destructor bodies. The C-style cast recovers the actual Derived object from its public, unambiguous, non-virtual Base subobject. This is an explicit standalone adaptation, not a claim of equivalence to the uninspected upstream simulator harness.

candidates.future_boundary: Independently source-reviewed target-family-safe supplemental evidence only; no all-rule safe claim, accepted independent quota, analyzer addressability, native qualification or evaluation freeze. The prior held proposal and its earlier review remain preserved in Git history.
